patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks, often with large headings left-aligned and supporting content below, creating a dynamic visual flow.
Overlapping, large-scale sans-serif typography used as a primary visual element, especially in the hero section, creating a bold and impactful statement.
High-contrast black and white/dark grey palette, creating a strong, modern, and minimalist aesthetic.
The hero image and main text parallax, with an additional 'SUNNY' text element revealing from the top and overlapping the main hero text as the user scrolls down.
The initial minimal 'Contact' link in the header transforms into a full navigation menu with a prominent 'Book Sunny' call to action once the user scrolls past the hero section.
Full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring a single dominant textual statement or a grid of placeholder content (e.g., 'Trusted advisor for industry leading brands').

technique_notes: Uses a scroll-triggered animation library (like locomotive-scroll) to create a layered parallax effect in the hero section, where an image and large text elements move at different speeds, and new text elements reveal from off-screen as the user scrolls down.

The initial minimal header navigation dynamically transforms into a more comprehensive sticky navigation bar with a distinct call to action once the user scrolls past the hero section, providing contextual navigation.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used as primary design elements, often overlapping or interacting with background images, requiring careful z-indexing and text contrast for readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold, wide sans-serif headings (up to ~6x body text size) with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical spacing between sections and generous internal padding, creating a sense of openness and focus on individual content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, overlapping typography as a primary visual and interactive element, particularly in the hero, combined with a high-contrast, minimalist aesthetic and sophisticated scroll-triggered animations, creates a dynamic and authoritative personal brand experience.
